plan.title: Heart treated vs control DE + pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: Raw Salmon gene-level counts (12,000 genes x 12 heart samples, 6 treated vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch, rRNA-depleted total RNA without UMIs) are analyzed for differential expression with DESeq2. Sample structure QC comes first because the profile flags a library-size outlier (sample_01, ~4x below median) and a duplication rate above 60% in most libraries — both must be inspected, not silently corrected, since duplicate removal without UMIs would delete true biological signal from highly expressed genes and depth differences are absorbed by DESeq2 size factors, not by dropping the sample. After QC, genes are minimally pre-filtered, size-factor normalized, and tested with the DESeq2 Wald test using an explicit reference level (control) and apeglm shrinkage of the fold change, with BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha 0.05. The Wald statistic ranks the full gene list for a preranked fgsea analysis against MSigDB Hallmark (staged locally) with Reactome as a confirmatory second collection (also staged locally), avoiding an ORA on a short significant-gene list per the flagged rule. A final report consolidates DE results, QC diagnostics, and enrichment findings with full reproducibility metadata.
